place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: If you love coffee and reading books, this is the perfect spot for you. Glad they finally have a branch in Davao. The place is so coozy. A lot book to choose from that you can barrow while staying in the cafe. Their desserts are perfect pairs in their coffee.

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: Waiting for the café to open when staff came in just minutes before 9…Chairs were on top of tables as I ordered. Still three months in operation. Cute interior with lots of books on wall shelves. Staff made a mistake with my drink, was apologetic. I let it slide. Menu has slim pickings with moderate rates. Hope they add more.

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: I recently visited this coffee shop and had a wonderful experience. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with comfortable seating and soft background music that made it a great place to relax or get some work done. The space was clean and well-organized, creating a cozy yet modern vibe. The staff were friendly and welcoming, taking the time to recommend drinks and ensuring orders were prepared quickly. I ordered a matcha and a pastry, and both were fresh and delicious. The coffee was rich and smooth, with a perfect balance of flavor and foam. Prices were reasonable for the quality offered, and the overall service exceeded my expectations. I would definitely return and recommend this spot to anyone looking for a comfortable place to enjoy great coffee.

place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: The place is neat and cozy, it's situated along a busy road but inside it's comfortable and quiet. Good for socializing and studying. Their drinks and food taste good. Seasalt vanilla cream latte's my favorite drink. I also tried the newest addition to their menu which is the tuna sandwich and it's affordable and very filling. Definitely worth the visit!

review_text: POV: You just found the best new coffee spot in Buhangin Davao. 😍 Whether you're looking for a place to study, catch up with friends, or just need a treat, Hills and Valleys Coffee in Buhangin is the vibe you've been looking for. place_name: Hills and Valleys Coffee - Buhangin Davao
review_text: Hoping they have variation in foods, but their cake is delicious, forgot what it's called, buttery with biscuit and nuts. The signature mint I ordered had crunchy bits of chocolate which is a nice touch, tastes like Dynamite candy 🤣. GF said the Biscoff was also delicious, but I didn't try it. The staff at the counter was friendly and accommodating to requests. Visited last Friday night.
